blocks.x: This is July 27th, 2010. We are in the apartment of Robert Steinberg at 920 Riverside Drive, Apartment 12H. I’m William A. Brower along with Kennith Kimery, conducting part two of the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History Project interview with James Wilbur Alexander Cobb. Jimmy, if I may, I want to go back to a few things during your time with Dinah Washington before we move forward. There’s some personalities, some names, that I’m unfamiliar with that maybe you might want to touch on. You did some stuff involving Charlie Singleton?
